This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] found within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were distinguished by their [[Changeling/Legends|polymorphic capabilitue]]. Upon [[Death/Legends|death]], members of this species will erupt into a bright ball of light before reverting to what may be their original form. One member of this species, [[Rulan Prolik]], served as one of the four overseers of [[GenoHaradan]]<ref name="KOTOR" /> by [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> though they were eventually killed by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] in the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] after impersonating members of the native [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] population such as [[Grarwwaar]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared within the<ref name="KOTOR" /> [[2003]]<ref name="Anniversary">{{SW|url=news/kotor-galaxy-of-heroes|text=BioWare and Capital Games on Bringing ''KotOR'' Fan Favorites into ''Galaxy of Heroes''|nolive=1}}</ref> video game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''. If the player accepts the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] quest, [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] kills Rulan in an alternate turn of events.<ref name="KOTOR" />
